Package io.github.janglada.orkit.scheduling

Class EmployeeConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.scheduling.EmployeeConfig
public final class EmployeeConfig extends Object
Fluent configurator for an employee, used inside the lambda passed to SchedulingBuilder.employee(String, java.util.function.Consumer).

    • minHoursPerWeek

      public EmployeeConfig minHoursPerWeek(int hours)
      Requires at least this many hours in every full week of the horizon (days 1-7, 8-14, ... from the horizon start); a trailing partial week is not constrained.

    • contractHoursPerWeek

      public EmployeeConfig contractHoursPerWeek(int hours)
      Contracted hours per full week of the horizon (as for minHoursPerWeek(int)). Every minute above or below is penalized with Goals.penalizeContractDeviation(long), or its default weight when that goal is not declared.

    • prefersShift

      public EmployeeConfig prefersShift(String shiftId)
      Records that this employee prefers the given shift id, every occurrence of it (used by honorEmployeePreferences()).

    • unavailableOn

      public EmployeeConfig unavailableOn(LocalDate... dates)
      Blocks one or more specific calendar dates regardless of day-of-week availability.

    • onHoliday

      public EmployeeConfig onHoliday(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Blocks every date in the inclusive range [from, to]. Use this for holidays, leave, or any multi-day absence.
